title: COBBLERS
content: an old fashioned dream.. I'm wondering if anyone has come across an old shop/tavern with a shoe repairs done 'whileuwait'. there's a bar that runs along one side of the room with tables, chairs and long benches on the opposite wall for the customers sat chatting, smoking, drinking, and eating or waiting for their shoes. the cobblers are at the back of the room, furthest away from the only door in/out. outside is a cobbled street that leads downhill (50yd) to a more modern high st. I just sat talking with the others and when I looked on the table for my drink I 'wasn't' surprised to find I was at my workbench, with some worn leather uppers in my hands... I'm the cobbler.!!
